ctgov.note: Trials returned by sponsor search are investigator-initiated or industry-sponsored studies in which TOI clinics participate as a site, not assets owned by TOI

commercial_product.description: TOI operates a network of community-based oncology clinics providing medical oncology, hematology, radiation oncology, clinical research site services, dispensary services, and value-based care arrangements with payors. TOI does not develop or own proprietary drug or device assets.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: The Oncology Institute is a community oncology services / clinic operator and clinical-trial site network (medical oncology, radiation oncology, dispensary, value-based care). It does not develop proprietary drug candidates. Trials appearing under its name in ClinicalTrials.gov are investigator-initiated or industry-sponsored studies in which TOI clinics participate as a site.
